project_type: Node.js CLI Tool with Desktop App (Electron + Vue 3)
language: JavaScript (ES6+), with Vue 3 for desktop app
build_system: npm with Vitest for testing, Vite for desktop app, Makefile for Debian packages
verification_instructions: 1. Run npm test to verify all tests pass 2. Run npm run lint to verify linting 3. Test CLI: node bin/cli.js --help
snapshot_or_generated_files: No snapshot files. Generated files are user outputs, not checked in
setup_instructions: 1. npm install 2. Tests should pass (1121+ tests)
environment_constraints: Node.js >=20.0.0 required. Project has existing test infrastructure with vitest.
contribution_requirements: Pre-commit hook runs lint-staged. Pre-push hook runs npm test.
key_patterns: ES6 modules (type: module in package.json). Export pattern: index.js exports public API. Core modules in lib/: analyzers, parsers, formatters, utils, core, plugins. Test files in test/ with *.test.js naming.
directory_structure: Root: CLI tool entry points (index.js, ctxman.js, bin/cli.js). lib/: core modules (analyzers, parsers, formatters, utils, core/, plugins/, api/, cache/, watch/, rag/, integrations/). test/: 77+ test files. docs/: documentation. docs/specs/features/: feature specifications.

existing_implementations.dashboard: lib/ui/dashboard.js exists as Ink-based React component. Spec requires text-based dashboard with ASCII charts for terminal output.
existing_implementations.dependency_scanner: Not implemented. Need to create lib/analyzers/dependency-scanner.js per spec in docs/specs/features/008-dependency-scanner.md
existing_implementations.typescript_migration_spec: Exists at docs/specs/modernization/003-typescript-migration.md. Needs update with detailed incremental migration guide.
